traps.question: Choose the natural, correct sentence.
options: She go to the market yesterday.
traps.explanation: Use have, not am having, for possession.

traps.question: Complete the correction: “Did she ___ the email?”
traps.explanation: After did, use the base form: did she send?

traps.question: Choose the correct preposition: “Please reply ___ this message.”
traps.explanation: We reply to a message, email, or question.

I miss the bus, so I take a taxi.
I missed the bus, so I take a taxi.
I was miss the bus, so I took taxi.
examQuestions.answer: I missed the bus, so I took a taxi.

options: She did not buy anything yesterday.

examQuestions.q: Choose the most appropriate spoken response.
options: Could you please tell me when the next train leaves?
Tell me next train when leave.
examQuestions.answer: Could you please tell me when the next train leaves?

examQuestions.q: Tell a short story about yesterday: where you went, what happened, and what you will do next time.

options: I am going to call the doctor tomorrow.
I going to call the doctor tomorrow.
I am go to call the doctor tomorrow.
I will going call the doctor tomorrow.
examQuestions.answer: I am going to call the doctor tomorrow.
